name: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, champion. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is.

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, champion!
narrative.objectives: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
